FLAMES calculator

Friends, Love, Affection, Marriage, Enemies or Siblings — play the classic FLAMES game with any two names.

Flames Calculator
The classic F-L-A-M-E-S elimination game — Friends, Love, Affection, Marriage, Enemies, Siblings.
For entertainment only.

How FLAMES is played

Write both names down and strike out every letter the two names have in common. Count the letters that are left. Then go round the word FLAMES, counting out that number and crossing off the letter you land on, until a single letter remains.

The calculator does exactly this for you, and shows which of the six letters survived. Like the paper version, it uses only the letters of the names, so the same pair always gives the same answer.

A game, not a prediction

FLAMES is a playground game and it is meant to be played that way. It cannot tell you whether a relationship will last or what kind it will be. If a relationship question is genuinely on your mind, a conversation with an astrologer will be far more useful than any letter count.

Frequently asked

Common questions

What does each letter in FLAMES stand for?

F is Friends, L is Love, A is Affection, M is Marriage, E is Enemies and S is Siblings.

Should I use full names or first names?

Either works, but they give different answers because the letter count changes. Most people play with first names.

Does the order of the names matter?

No. The letters crossed out are the same whichever name comes first, so the count and the result do not change.
